name: Yongzheng Emperor
contribution: The fourth emperor of the Qing dynasty, and the third Qing emperor to rule over China proper.

checks.lead: The Yongzheng Emperor (13 December 1678 – 8 October 1735), also known by his temple name Emperor Shizong of Qing, personal name Yinzhen, was the fourth emperor of the Qing dynasty, and the third Qing emperor to rule over China proper.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
